### workspace parent --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace parent [NAME] [--name NAME] [--path] [--json | --json-envelope]

Print the parent workspace of the current (or given) workspace.
In a non-worktree workspace, prints its own name.

        --name NAME                  Workspace to answer for instead of the current directory's (the same as NAME)
        --path                       Print the parent's root directory instead of its name
        --json                       Print name, path, git_common_dir, is_worktree, worktree as JSON
        --json-envelope              Print the same under a "parent" key in the standard envelope (implies --json)

Examples:
  workspace parent    # the parent of the current directory's workspace
  workspace parent app.worktree-login    # the parent of a named workspace
  workspace parent --name app.worktree-login    # in a script, where the flag reads clearer than a bare name
  workspace parent --path    # the parent's root directory
  workspace parent --json    # name, path, git_common_dir, is_worktree, worktree
--- stderr
--- end
